headline: Deputy proposes allocating Bishkek a loan of 3 billion soms for purchasing buses
summary: A Jogorku Kenesh deputy has proposed a budget loan of 3 billion soms to the Bishkek city administration to buy new buses. The proposal was made in parliament.
why: Municipal budget loans fund public transport and infrastructure, and their approval determines how local government spending is financed.
original_headline: Нардеп предложил выделить Бишкеку ссуду в 3 миллиарда сомов на закупку автобусов
